    SELECT
        fixmedins_code,
        fixmedins_name,
        dise_name,
        setl_id,
        medfee_sumamt
    FROM

    WHERE

        toYear(setl_time) = 2024

        fixmedins_code,
        fixmedins_name,
        dise_name,
        -- 总结算频次
        COUNT(setl_id) AS total_count,

                WHEN medfee_sumamt BETWEEN 90 AND 110 OR medfee_sumamt BETWEEN 490 AND 510 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END

    FROM
        filtered_data
    GROUP BY
        fixmedins_code,

    -- 计算此特征结算频次占总体结算的比重
    ROUND(special_count / total_count, 2) AS special_ratio
FROM
    count_data
WHERE
    -- 筛选出比重超过 80% 的基层诊所
    special_ratio > 0.8;
